translations.web: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.
translations.bsb: “Be careful not to perform your righteous acts before men to be seen by them. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.
translations.kjv: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
translations.asv: Take heed that ye do not your righteousness before men, to be seen of them: else ye have no reward with your Father who is in heaven.
